strongest_changes: The transitory crossing became durable, witnessed evidence.
The reciprocal gesture became a silent verdict and a self-appointed monitoring signal.
Commercial cues recast ridicule as social short-measure.
The mirrored ending placed the passing act inside a measured return circuit.
summary.what_was_special: One focus root sustained coexisting route, recurrence, bitterness, and twisted-cord images. Context did not collapse them into one answer; it activated economic, evidentiary, semiotic, habitual, spatial, relay, jurisdictional, and reversal mechanisms around the same brief act.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus root at word 4 has no branch inventory, so its contribution is limited to visible reciprocal morphology and constructional structure.
83:31 may carry a retold caricature home, or it may preserve only the passers' mood.
The bitter-palate and tightened-cord readings may be productive semantic halos or may remain too branch-distant for anything beyond qualified exploratory use.
